correctness.rationale: The two-piece division invariant is proved equal to the two-equal-ball packing radius by explicit separation in both directions. For an orthotope, centers of radius-r balls form the eroded orthotope and two balls fit exactly when its diameter is at least 2r. The resulting quadratic is strictly decreasing on the entire admissible radius interval, giving the piecewise closed form. When the optimum is nonsaturated, every optimal division forces a diameter pair in the eroded orthotope, hence opposite vertices and the unique tangent separating hyperplane.
